mapper.select: select id, registration_id, season_id, team_id, player_id, member_id, team_member_id, roster_role, jersey_no, is_starting, is_captain, validation_status, reject_reason, sort_no, create_time, update_time, is_delete from basket_tournament_registration_player where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0

select rp.id as registration_player_id, rp.player_id, rp.member_id, ifnull(nullif(p.game_nickname, ''), mp.nickname) as player_name, p.player_no, rp.jersey_no, rp.roster_role, rp.is_starting, rp.is_captain from basket_tournament_registration_player rp inner join basket_tournament_registration r on rp.registration_id = r.id and r.is_delete = 0 and r.registration_status = 3 left join basket_player_profile p on rp.player_id = p.id and p.is_delete = 0 left join basket_member_profile mp on mp.member_id = p.member_id and mp.is_delete = 0 where rp.season_id = #{seasonId} and rp.team_id = #{teamId} and rp.is_delete = 0 and rp.validation_status = 1 order by rp.sort_no, rp.id

select id, registration_id, season_id, team_id, player_id, member_id, team_member_id, roster_role, jersey_no, is_starting, is_captain, validation_status, reject_reason, sort_no, create_time, update_time, is_delete from basket_tournament_registration_player where registration_id = #{registrationId} and is_delete = 0 order by sort_no

select rp.id, rp.player_id as playerId, rp.member_id as memberId, rp.roster_role as rosterRole, rp.jersey_no as jerseyNo, rp.is_captain as isCaptain, rp.is_starting as isStarting, rp.validation_status as validationStatus, rp.reject_reason as rejectReason, p.position_code as positionCode, ifnull(nullif(p.game_nickname, ''), mp.nickname) as playerNickname, p.player_no as playerNo from basket_tournament_registration_player rp left join basket_player_profile p on p.id = rp.player_id and p.is_delete = 0 left join basket_member_profile mp on mp.member_id = rp.member_id and mp.is_delete = 0 where rp.registration_id = #{registrationId} and rp.is_delete = 0 order by rp.sort_no, rp.id
mapper.update: update basket_tournament_registration_player set validation_status = #{validationStatus}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
